name: PASSOVER_LAMB
canonical: a young male lamb without blemish of the first year, white-fleeced and whole, kept four days then slain at twilight with not a bone broken. The Passover lamb of Exodus 12 — NOT a fluffy toy lamb, NOT a grown ram, NOT a wounded or broken carcass; perfect and unblemished
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
